status: draft source-authored finite expectations; independent review required before candidate execution; not whole S03 acceptance
identity_policy: Expected id labels are aliases bound by unique complete source Locator plus collection-specific record kind, never package name/purl equality. Resolve reference IDs only through these bindings; exact full record fields and contextual multisets required. Duplicate/ambiguous anchors refuse rather than merge. All collections including empty ones must match. Only explicitly set-valued ID reference lists ignore order; all source locations/ranges/contexts remain exact. Order-insensitive ID lists are exactly selection_declaration_ids, root_ids, analysis_scope_ids and installed_environment_ids; sorting retains duplicate entries. No other array normalization is allowed.
controller_policy: Require fixture source hashes, explicit source-free preserve-alternatives environment, schema_version, producer/config/registry identity and numerical limits separately; these fixture expectations do not prove controller custody. Export/matching stays not-run during composition.

java-gradle-lock.adjudication: Original fixture GAV/configuration and exact source line/hash retained. Lock-input scope does not establish a project root; activation/directness remain unknown and no dependency edges are inferred. Prior source_adjudication_sha256 applies to original four cases only.
